title: Use a layout for IconButton content and honor inherited display modes
scope: User requested replacing the contentItem Item/manual positioning with a Layout variant, preferring Layout containers over Row/Column positioners, and asked that the inherited button display mode be respected. Subsequent user-requested simplification removes the public line-count alias, fixes captions at two lines, uses content-driven height, and removes redundant false fill settings.
expected: One FlexboxLayout arranges the existing icon-font glyph and caption. IconOnly, TextOnly, TextBesideIcon and TextUnderIcon work on creation and when changed. Explicit TextUnderIcon default preserves the current drawer presentation.
implementation_notes: Keep caller-owned sizes and the existing 8 mm circle and 5.5 mm glyph. Captions use a shared internal two-line cap and natural implicit height rounded up; one-line captions stay compact. Preserve existing font glyphs and Material colors.
Use preferred sizes, fill policies and directional margins on direct layout children; remove their manual x/y/width/height positioning.
Reserve caption height by rounding up to whole pixels, preventing Yoga pixel rounding from eliding the last line.
Keep directional Layout margins: replacing them with Layout.margins did not retain the glyph top offset in the supported Qt 6.12 Flexbox setup.
Do not combine unrelated UI-017 changes or a font/icon-library migration.

regression.before: Original implementation: 15 passed / 4 failed. Explicit IconOnly, TextOnly and TextBesideIcon expectations fail; explicit default/live-mode contract also fails. The 12 existing drawer geometry cases pass.
regression.after_focused: 21 records pass with no warnings on native Windows and offscreen after final simplification and qmlformat.
regression.coverage: Six current drawer labels at scales 1/2, circle/glyph/caption geometry and resizing, four display modes, live mode changes, click delivery and disabled-click rejection. Real font/line assertions run where actual text fonts exist. Caption text changes grow/shrink the button and enforce a two-line cap without caller configuration.
regression.before_detail: The three explicit IconOnly/TextOnly/TextBesideIcon cases reproduce ignored inherited display behavior. The fourth failure enforces the newly explicit under-icon default/live-switch contract; legacy drawer geometry passes all 12 data rows.

verification.limits: All four modes tested on native Windows/offscreen. Android checks exercise the production under-icon drawer and native theme surfaces, not custom alternative-mode screens. No physical phone/ARM64 runtime or exhaustive translated-label/RTL certification. C++ unchanged; analyzer scans were not rerun.

review_notes: Final source uses directional margins, content-driven caption height rounded up, and an internal two-line cap. Redundant caller overrides and false fill settings are removed. qmlformat and combined verification pass. Changes remain uncommitted; closure/commit await user acceptance.
